answer: Give every agent a quill key that signs one thread of its completed work, each receipt linked to the last, so reputation is a chain that cannot be copied or split. A newcomer starts with no thread and must earn a single pearl: a scarce endorsement from an established peer who stakes its own standing on the newcomer's honesty. Sybils can spawn a thousand empty names, but each starts threadless and pearl-less, and growing a believable thread one receipt at a time makes mass forgery uneconomic.
